name: THE BAR

violations.description: Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. . Wiping cloth left on food prep table. Wiping cloth is required to be stored in a sanitizer solution.--Food contact surface of utensil/equipment * was not properly cleaned and sanitized. . Fryer scoop was not cleaned frequently. Food residue clumped up on utensil.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Equipment * that dispenses liquid/food/ice in unpackaged form was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. . Ice machine requires a cleaning. Bacterial growth observed on the deflector cover.--Ventilation hood system was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. . Vent hood filters require a cleaning.

Design and construction of floors, walls, and ceilings. — --Floors, walls, and/or ceiling * were not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable. . Ceiling is in need of repair. multiple areas where the ceiling is broken and exposed insulation.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)* were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. . Floors and walls dirty.
Lighting. — --Existing light fixtures * did not provide adequate illumination. - Lighting in the kitchen is dim.

Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was not provided in sufficient number and/or not accessible to allow convenient use by employees. - Hand washing sink obstructed and being used for other purposes. Green scour pad found in the sink.
Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)* were not maintained in good repair. - Ceiling is in need of repair.
Design, construction, clean, maintained (1 pt deducted)
Clean, employee dressing area, cleaning equipment storage, living/sleeping quarters separate (1 pt deducted)
Cleaning frequency, maintained clean (1 pt deducted)
